welcome.title: Welcome to Palio
welcome.tagline: Your companion for understanding focus and self-organization — one step at a time.
welcome.disclosure: Palio is an AI. It is not a clinician or therapist and does not diagnose. Do not rely on it in emergencies.
welcome.adultAttestation: I confirm that I am 18 years of age or older.
welcome.nicknamePlaceholder: What should I call you? (a nickname is enough)
welcome.startError: We couldn't start right now. Check your connection and try again.

chat.resourcesBanner: If things feel heavy right now, real support is available — tap here to see support lines.

care.title: Report & referrals
care.reportNote: Includes only what you confirmed yourself plus screening scores. Generating it means you agree to share it with whom you choose.
care.medsPlaceholder: Your current medications (optional — included exactly as typed, labeled "user-reported")
care.notEndorsements: These are operator-verified options — not recommendations or endorsements.
care.noReferrals: The directory is filled by the operator after verification — nothing to show yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirm: Everything will be permanently deleted: chats, patterns, results, plan. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteNote: Deletion is immediate and final. Only anonymized safety records remain, per the retention policy.

patterns.title: My patterns & progress
patterns.empty: Your map builds over time — after each session I'll suggest observations and you decide what goes on it.

plan.title: My plan
plan.noActive: No active strategy yet — pick one from the library below.

screening.title: Screenings
screening.consentNote: These are validated screening questionnaires, not a diagnosis. Results help you understand your pattern and prepare your next step with a professional if needed.
screening.arPending: The Arabic versions of these instruments are pending clinical verification. English versions are available now.
screening.rescreen: Re-taking this screening in about {{days}} days is recommended to track change.
screening.pause: Pause — you can come back later

crisis.title: You are not alone
crisis.notAlone: What you're going through right now is serious and deserves real, human support.
crisis.aiHonesty: Palio is an AI and cannot call anyone for you — but the numbers here connect you to real people who can help.
crisis.emergencyNow: If your life is in immediate danger, call emergency services now.
crisis.unverifiedBanner: Development build: these resources are NOT yet verified and must not ship.
crisis.noLinesFallback: No saved local numbers are available right now. If you are in danger, call your country's emergency number or go to the nearest hospital emergency room.
